summary: End-to-end backend + frontend verification of Memo No., Payment Status, Party Ledger and Latest-First Invoice features. Backend: ran the full GST regression suite (test_gst_billing + test_gst_item_bulk_history + test_gst_item_master_sync + test_excel_branded_exports + test_discrepancy_invoices + test_discrepancy_extras + new test_invoice_memo_payment_ledger) = 87 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed. New test file covers: compute_payment_fields for Paid/Partial/Pending with ±₹1 tolerance, memo_no fallback to invoice_number, GET /gst/invoices includes new fields and is sorted latest-first, PUT recomputes payment_status, POST /backfill-payments idempotent (second call updated=0), GET /party-ledger/customers distinct & sorted DESC, GET /party-ledger by phone/name/period/custom-date returns rows+totals+customer with totals.count consistent, Excel export contains 6 new tail cols ['Memo No.','Cash Received','Online Received','Total Paid','Pending Amount','Payment Status'], PDF endpoint returns application/pdf bytes. Frontend (admin login → /gst-billing): verified Memo No. column (50 memo-{id} cells) + Payment column (50 payment-status-{id} colour-coded badges Paid/Partial/Pending), default sort latest-first, New Invoice dialog has inv-memo-no / inv-cash-received / inv-online-received, View Invoice dialog shows view-payment-block with Cash/Online/Pending/Status rows, Party Ledger tab between Discrepancies and Reports with ledger-customer-search, ledger-period, ledger-no-selection, customer picker (16 buttons after TEST_LEDGER prefix search), selecting customer renders ledger-totals tile (Invoices/Invoice Value/Cash+Online/Pending/GST Collected) + 2 ledger-row-{id} rows latest first, Custom range period switch shows ledger-start-date & ledger-end-date.
critical_code_review_comments: backfill-payments query uses $or on payment_status/memo_no empty — since final fallback always sets memo_no = invoice_number, second run yields updated=0. Idempotency depends on this invariant; if the schema ever supports nullable memo_no without fallback, idempotency would break. Consider an explicit `_backfilled_at` marker for clarity.
compute_payment_fields treats grand_total <= 0 as blank status. This is fine for cancelled-line invoices but list-row consumers should defensively handle empty payment_status (UI already shows '—').
Party-ledger name-prefix uses case-insensitive regex with re.escape — safe from injection; no concerns.

success_rate.backend: 100% (87/87 GST tests, 1 pre-existing skip; 16/16 new tests)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_CUST_* / TEST_LEDGER_* invoices during automated runs. These remain in the gst_invoices collection (manual cleanup possible via /gst-billing). Safe to leave for next iteration's regression — they participate in latest-first sort and ledger tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backfill is verified idempotent: production data was already backfilled (run #1 in this iter reported some updates of newly-created Paid/Partial/Pending invoices that had no sale_id but still matched on empty payment_status; second call returns updated=0). The known cosmetic hydration warning about <span> in <tbody> and <th>/<td> from radix Tabs/Dialog is per spec — do NOT flag. Excel export header is on row 5+ (rows 1-4 hold brand banner & metadata); the new 6 columns are always the last 6 in the header row.
rca of the issue: No bug. All requested features pass backend + frontend verification end-to-end.
